name: Campingplatz Litzelau
beschreibung:
Overview

The entry Campingplatz Litzelau was listed as a camping establishment in the Tyrol tourism portal for the Kitzbühel region. However, when checked against official sources, it could not be confirmed that this establishment is actually located in Tyrol (Austria). The phone number given in the entry has the German area code +49 8640, and the email and website point to the domain camping-litzelau.de. The coordinates given (around 47.717 N / 12.479 E) also lie in the border area with Bavaria and not in the Kitzbühel area. The establishment is therefore listed as unverified for the Tyrol portal. A campsite of the same name, on the other hand, is documented on official pages of the municipality of Unterwössen and of the operator in the Upper Bavarian Chiemgau.

History/Background

There is no history of the establishment documented by official Tyrolean sources. The entry itself does not mention any founding dates, owners, or historical development. The details in the differing Bavarian sources refer to a location outside Tyrol. For this reason, no historical claims about a Tyrolean establishment are made here. All that can be established is that the name Litzelau refers to a hamlet of the same name near Unterwössen on the edge of the Chiemgau Alps. This suggests that the dataset's assignment to the federal state of Tyrol is erroneous and that the entry probably originally came from a different regional context.

Arrival

Since the establishment's affiliation with Tyrol could not be verified, no officially confirmed travel routes within Tyrol can be given. For the location of the same name in the Chiemgau, the Litzelau locality near Unterwössen is documented; the region is accessed via the roads and the railway connection of the Achental. A reliable statement about parking facilities, railway stations, or bus lines in the surroundings of the establishment listed here is not possible on the basis of the official sources examined and is therefore deliberately left open.

Tips

For datasets whose assignment to Tyrol is unclear, it is advisable to verify the address, phone number, and operating entity directly with the establishment or the responsible municipality before publication. Since no verified Tyrolean address is available for the entry described here, details on prices and opening hours should not be adopted unless confirmed by an official source of the establishment. Interested guests should contact the contact point given in the entry by phone or email before booking and clarify the exact location.

Best time to travel

No statement based on official sources can be made about the best time to travel for this establishment, since its assignment to Tyrol is not verified. In general, the Alpine foothills and the adjacent Chiemgau are suitable for hiking both in spring and in autumn, while the summer months offer the warmest conditions. For winter stays, the region on the edge of the Alps is generally rich in snow, but specific details on the establishment's seasons are not documented and are therefore not stated.
